About Me

iOS Developer

A creative software engineer with a passion for Swift

I’m an iOS engineer who loves building software that feels thoughtful, useful, and human. What excites me most about mobile development is the chance to create new ways for people to interact with technology and to solve meaningful problems through carefully crafted code. I care deeply about Swift, Apple platforms, and the discipline of writing good software, and I’m incredibly grateful to be part of the broader iOS development community.
